title.narrative: Lao PDR Introducing Public Opinion Surveys

description.narrative: The development objective of this grant is to contribute to the enhancement of the capacity of the Lao Social Science institute, in particular in the area of public opinion survey research. With a young population (%)% is under the age of 20), internal and external migration, and being based in an economically dynamic region, Lao PDR is experiencing a high degree of social and cultural change. The Government would like to better understand what is driving this change, its impact on society and how the Government can be responsive. In response to a request from the Ministry of Information and Culture, a priority for the Lao Social Sciences Institute is to build capacity to allow the institute to better understand the social and cultural changes that are taking place, particularly among young people in the capital city, but also among other groups and in the country more broadly. Funding from IDF would allow the WB to support this priority, by contributing to better research capacity at the Institute, as well as introducing non-conventional research surveys, such as public opinion surveys, which are still new in the country. The Australian Embassy in Vientiane has agreed to co-finance this work. Specifically the IDF would support two components: COMPONENT 1: Strategic technical assistance inputs to strengthen the Lao Social Sciences Institute#s ability to design and execute a program in conventional social science research COMPONENT 2: Strategic technical assistance inputs to strengthen the Lao Social Sciences Institute's ability to design and execute specialized survey research. This component would also include piloting public opinion surveys in Vientiane capital plus two additional locations. Outcomes include: - establishment of an updated social science research program at the Institute for Social Sciences - Public opinion surveys undertaken in Vientiane capital and two other locations - Key findings from public opinion survey(s) / research used to inform policy making or identifying strategy The development objective is to contribute to improved capacity of the Lao Social Sciences Institute, by: i) providing technical assistance to the Institute on developing a contemporary research program and techniques; and ii) piloting public opinion surveys in three locations.
